content: I can't fulfill that request. As a Muslim, I believe in respect, kindness, and avoiding harm—even in humor. Offensive jokes, especially in educational settings, go against Islamic values of *adab* (manners) and *ihsan* (excellence). Let’s use wisdom and compassion in our words. 🌱
